datasets.name: RFC Editor Text Collection
datasets.description: Complete text RFC, BCP, STD, FYI, and IEN publication collection and indexes.
datasets.attribution: RFC authors, RFC Editor, and IETF Trust
datasets.update_frequency: monthly snapshot or before an offline release
datasets.scope: RFC Editor rfcs-text-only module plus publication metadata
datasets.notes: Acquired 10,057 regular files (555,449,714 bytes) from the official rsync module with a complete SHA-256 inventory; symlink aliases are intentionally omitted. Parsed 9,822 primary rfc*.txt publications into 348,831 chunks, preserving RFC number, publication date/status, ISSN, obsoletes, and updates metadata. Published and source-verified 348,831 Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B vectors at 256 dimensions. The final routed/reranked exact-query gate retains Success@1 and MRR@10 of 1.0. Deterministic evidence reranking recovers all six original paraphrase cases in the first 10 and improves expanded 18-query Success@10 from 0.888889 to 0.944444.

datasets.license: CC0 1.0 Universal (IANA/IETF Protocol Registries joint statement)
datasets.update_frequency: monthly snapshot or before an offline release
datasets.scope: complete machine-readable XML/CSV registry exports; HTML retained only when needed for context
datasets.notes: Acquired the complete official assignments rsync snapshot: 8,269 regular files and 70,672,402 bytes with aggregate SHA-256 7c8e859136528cfe12aab4840f837ede1d8054541c50a7126cdcb8c05257b462. Parsed 675 IANA registry XML files into 4,256 nested registry documents, 110,423 structured table records, and 114,590 chunks. The six-case lexical gate achieved Success@1, MRR@10, Recall@50, and nDCG@10 of 1.0.

datasets.name: SQLite Documentation
datasets.description: Official SQLite language, API, architecture, file-format, and operational documentation.
datasets.scope: complete official generated documentation for one pinned stable release
datasets.notes: Acquired the official 11,820,412-byte SQLite 3.53.4 documentation archive and verified publisher SHA3-256 7ccf86a52e7dd1fb9b31e63edcebe3b553f18f89cd26eef59c7f191a5111836e. Parsed 837 HTML files into 765 documents and 4,384 chunks, skipping 72 navigation/index-only pages after structure filtering. The 20-query lexical gate achieved Success@1 0.95, Success@5 1.0, MRR@10 0.975, Recall@50 1.0, and nDCG@10 0.966274. A source-verified Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B generation covers every chunk at 256 dimensions. On 12 paraphrase cases, warm hybrid retrieval achieved Success@10 0.916667 and Recall@50 1.0; routed deterministic reranking raised Success@5 from 0.833333 to 0.916667 while preserving the exact-query gate.
